sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
path = ['RIGHT']*5 + ['UP']*25 + ['LEFT']*15 + ['DOWN']*10 + ['LEFT']*5 + ['DOWN']*20
i = 0
def cart_pos():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='O' and 8<=n['pixels']<=12:
            r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']); c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            return (r0,c0)
    return None
for b in range(3):
    if i>=len(path): break
    batch=path[i:i+8]
    r=action(batch, intent='solve')
    i+=len(batch)
    if r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done') or r.get('game_over'):
        print("STOP: level_completed",r.get('level_completed'),"done",r.get('done'),"game_over",r.get('game_over'))
        break
    print(f"batch {b+1} done, i={i}/{len(path)}, cart={cart_pos()}, step={current_frame.step}")
print("remaining:",len(path)-i)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
